text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Calstone Light O is amazing! She 
looked like she was running so 
effortlessly, right!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it was a total contrast to the Asahi 
Hai FS. Felt like a true sprinter's run, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's like she grew two or three steps all 
at once! She's definitely gotten faster, 
so I'm looking forward to the next one!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what was our top speed today!?
choice_data_list:
You're 5 km/h faster than during the 
"Asahi Hai FS"!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Which means... yahooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I've broken my top speed once again! A 
complete success!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you very much! I just want 
to give you a big hug to show my 
gratitude!
choice_data_list: I'll gratefully accept the thought!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let me offer a dance of 
gratitude in return!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O expresses her gratitude 
with a mysterious dance. She must be that 
thrilled.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I'm glad I stayed true to the path of 
pursuing speed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Within her desire to become faster lies 
her boundless potential.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even faster—so fast that no one can catch 
up. I will surely guide her to the very 
end of that horizon!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, at Calstone Light O's 
request, we decided to sightsee around 
Kyoto City before heading back. Since 
we're on a trip, taking a breather isn't a 
bad idea.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I love the Kyoto cityscape. 
Don't you think it's beautiful?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, the old buildings just blend right 
into the townscape—

Yeah, the old buildings blend right into 
the townscape—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not! It's a street, a street! 
Look at how magnificent this grid layout 
is!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Straights and more straights!! This is the 
best!
choice_data_list: There!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my legs are aching to run. I want to 
sprint down that street! If only there 
were no traffic lights...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's head down and walk along that 
straight road!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...If we're not careful, will this just 
end up as a sightseeing tour of walking on 
roads? I'll look for the right moment to 
suggest other sights..."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, a trout's swimming speed is 
roughly 35 km/h... Not even worth 
mentioning, small fry!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Aha! So that is why "small fry" is written 
with the characters for "miscellaneous 
fish"!?
choice_data_list: ...That's not it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Is that not it? Hmph, the Japanese 
language is truly profound...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, looks like there's a dolphin show too. 
Let's check it out, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I am looking forward to it. I wonder how 
many kilometers per hour dolphins can 
swim!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"So what caught your eye was speed after 
all. Still, I'm glad to see you're 
enjoying yourself."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Time flew by in the blink of an eye, and 
while I was looking at souvenirs at the 
shop—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The dolphin cookies are the most popular, 
huh? As expected of the fastest creature 
in this aquarium, they're quite a hit.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Well, I am faster, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bam! Thump thump thump!)

text_block_list.name: Male Aquarium Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Ouch! ...Whoa, whoa-whoa-whoa! The 
merchandise!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A male customer turned around after 
paying, bumped his bags into the shelf, 
and spilled everything. From the impact, 
the items on the display table all came 
crashing down at once.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Are you all right? Let me help.

text_block_list.name: Male Aquarium Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you! That helps a lot! ...Ngh, 
I've got to hurry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Constantly checking his watch, the man 
frantically gathered up his dropped 
belongings.
choice_data_list:
Um, do you happen to have plans after 
this?

text_block_list.name: Male Aquarium Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the train's departure time is 
approaching, and I have to transfer to the 
Shinkansen after...

text_block_list.name: Male Aquarium Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Going back to Tokyo, and then taking the 
Shinkansen home from there. If I miss my 
scheduled transfer, I won't be able to get 
home until tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Dolphin cookies and a penguin plushie. 
You must have a little one waiting at 
home."

text_block_list.name: Male Aquarium Visitor
text_block_list.text:
That's right. He's working away from 
home... so it's been a while since we last 
saw each other. But if he finds out I 
won't be home until tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Leave the cleanup to me. Please hurry to 
the station.

text_block_list.name: Male Aquarium Visitor
text_block_list.text: A-Are you sure...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If we don't make it in time, we'll miss 
the train! And if we miss it, we can't go 
home! Hurry, now!
choice_data_list: Don't mind me, please go on ahead!

text_block_list.name: Male Aquarium Visitor
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Excuse me, pardon my intrusion!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apologizing profusely, the man dashed 
toward the exit. After seeing him off, I 
helped Calstone Light O rearrange the 
fallen merchandise.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the placement is off. Move it 3 
millimeters to the right.
choice_data_list: 3mm!? ...Around here?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
You're 5 mm too far to the right! A little 
more to the left... Yes, right there!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: It's finished!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I managed to line up the merchandise 
neatly. Straight along the edges of the 
square table.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stacked without a millimeter of 
misalignment, the display stands like a 
chimney, radiating an intense presence. 
...I could've sworn they were originally 
arranged in the shape of a heart.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It feels so nice when they're lined up 
neatly! It looks like we'll sell a lot... 
Oh?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There's one more at your feet, Trainer... 
It's a train keychain.
choice_data_list:
Trains? Doesn't look like they have any 
train merchandise, though...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ! That man from earlier...?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Please lend it to me! I'll run to the 
station!!
choice_data_list: I'm counting on you!
Please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving the aquarium, I chased after 
Calstone Light O. Then, she came back from 
the direction she had gone.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I missed it by just a split second...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: If only I were faster...!
choice_data_list: No, it's too early to give up!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: !? Trainer, do you have a plan?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I recall the scenery I saw with her from 
the hilltop earlier. It's only one station 
from the nearest stop to Kyoto Station.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And half of that section goes through this 
park, while the other half runs parallel 
to the road.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, we can dash in a straight 
line. If we cut straight through this 
park, we can shorten the distance.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If I take the shortest route... I can 
catch up to the train at Kyoto Station!
choice_data_list: Yeah. With your legs, I know you can...!

Yeah. With legs like yours, I know you 
can...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I will catch up, I swear it!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her back distanced itself in an instant. 
Feeling the wind she stirred in her wake, 
I started running along that very same 
path.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
(Is that it...? The tail car. If I can see 
it, it's not far!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
(I will catch you! I will overtake you! 
And I will deliver... this souvenir!!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer told me so, too. I know I can do 
it!!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
We're neck and neck! It starts now!! 
Oooohhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O pulls up alongside the 
train. She quickens her stride and 
accelerates even further.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Becoming a black arrow, she ran even 
faster. Catching the sunlight, she turned 
into a single beam of light.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right now, her speed is faster than a 
train—!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A flash of light pierces through. Is what 
I'm seeing right now truly real?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, the pounding of hooves against the 
turf shatters the illusion. This is 
reality. This is—an Umamusume running at 
her absolute limit!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With the speed of light itself, Calstone 
Light O left the train in the dust."
choice_data_list:
H... Haha, amazing... You're amazing, 
Light O!

H... Haha, amazing... You're amazing, 
Light O!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected, her true brilliance shines 
through in the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!? You're drenched in sweat. 
You're in a worse state than I am, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Were you really so worried that you cast 
all shame aside?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! I delivered the souvenirs to 
your dad! Now your whole family will be 
happy and harmonious!
choice_data_list: Light O! I've decided on your next race!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"The next race? How sudden. Do people 
often tell you your conversations lack 
context?"
choice_data_list: Sorry, I got a little too carried away...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing it pointed out by her of all 
people brought me back to my senses. 
Witnessing Calstone Light O's true worth 
had gotten me overly excited...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: So, what about the next race?
choice_data_list:
It's a graded stakes race where you can 
run your absolute fastest!

It's the graded race where you can run the 
fastest!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It goes without saying, but a straight 
course is the most suitable for pursuing 
top speed."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With no corners, she can accelerate all 
the way to top speed in a single burst.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And among the straight-course races, there 
is a single, newly established graded 
stakes.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ! Could that be...!
choice_data_list: Let's enter the Ibis Summer Dash!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Niigata Racecourse, 1000m straight course! 
The Ibis Summer Dash!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The maximum-speed running Calstone Light O 
strives for. It is on the straight course 
that her true worth shines.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want everyone to experience that kind of 
speed for themselves.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neither words nor numbers could ever 
capture it. That sudden, breathtaking gust 
of wind—
choice_data_list:
Let's show everyone the top speed you're 
aiming for.

Let's show everyone the top speed you're 
aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm confident when it comes to 
straights! Let's record the top speed at 
the Ibis Summer Dash!
